name: Holy Shield
description: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 95 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active.  Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges. [S03 - Tuning and Overrides Passive - All Classes: Activating Holy Shield also grants you 2 Spell Power for each point of your defense skill beyond (60 * 5). Lasts 15 sec]
